Name: (AT) Ali's Modern Farm Buildings
Author: lianace
Description:
[size=3]By popular demand, I converted Ali's Modern Farm Buildings to alternative textures. [b]It does not include the slime hutch or the junimo hut[/b], since the size of them was changed in 1.6 and I couldn't get the texture to look right. strawberrymilk95 is no longer active in the modding community, and has given people permission to update their mods.[/size]

[size=3]This mod does not replace the original buildings, it simply adds additional textures that you can set using [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][size=3]. You will need to have AT installed, and purchase the paint bucket tool from Robin to customize the buildings.[/size][size=3]

[size=3]All the credit goes to strawberrymilk95 for the textures used. All I did was convert their work to AT.[/size]
